stories.title: Youth Congress protests at Meta offices, issues 7-day ultimatum
factBox: On 20 Nov 2026, Indian Youth Congress workers protested at Meta's offices in Hyderabad, Mumbai and Gurugram over restricted Instagram accounts of IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib and national in-charge Manish Sharma; 21 were detained in Hyderabad and released after about three hours.

The IYC says both accounts were restored shortly after the protests and has given Meta a 7-day ultimatum to lift restrictions on opposition voices, journalists and creators; Meta declined to comment, and the BJP accused the protesters of vandalising Meta's Hyderabad office.

Meta's disclosures show it restricted more than 5.4 million posts or accounts in India under local laws in January–June 2026, after the government cut the deadline for removing unlawful content from 36 hours to 3 hours in February 2026.

stories.title: Congress says Centre still lacks two-thirds majority for delimitation
factBox: On 21 Nov 2026, Congress's Jairam Ramesh said the 'PM-HM jodi' was still searching for a two-thirds Lok Sabha majority to pass the delimitation Constitutional Amendment Bill, 100 days after the Monsoon Session was adjourned sine die without being prorogued.

The earlier Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026, which sought to redistribute Lok Sabha seats on the basis of the 2011 Census to speed up women's reservation, was defeated on 17 April 2026: 298 votes for, 230 against, short of the 352 needed.

Ramesh proposed keeping the current Lok Sabha strength and state-wise seats, with one-third reservation for women, frozen until the 'Viksit Bharat' goal is met, citing delimitation freezes in 1976 and 2001.

stories.title: Adani Defence demonstrates Bagheera AT1 anti-tank missile at Pokhran
factBox: Adani Defence & Aerospace demonstrated its vehicle-mounted Bagheera AT1 anti-tank guided missile system at the Pokhran Field Firing Ranges on 20 Nov 2026, firing four missiles in day and night engagements before Army, Department of Military Affairs and Defence Ministry officials.

The company says the system has a range of up to 8 km, about double the roughly 4 km of the Army's current ground-launched anti-tank missiles, uses jamming-resistant laser beam-riding guidance, and carries 12 missiles per vehicle.
It was a 'No Cost No Commitment' demonstration after 18 months of development; the system is now available for evaluation by the armed forces, and no order has been announced.

stories.title: Cyclone Akvan weakens into depression; no major damage in Odisha
factBox: Cyclone Akvan crossed the coast near Gopalpur, Odisha, on 20 Nov 2026 with winds of 70–80 kmph gusting to 90 kmph, and then weakened into a depression, according to the IMD.
Odisha shifted over 4.40 lakh people to safety, deployed 423 rescue teams and set up 9,341 cyclone shelters; Disaster Management Minister Suresh Pujari said there was no major damage or loss of life.
Around 1,450 babies were born to mothers moved to safety during the cyclone, the third storm to threaten Odisha in 24 days; 14 flights were cancelled at Ranchi on 21 Nov due to the bad weather.

scripts.topic: Delete in 3 Hours, Explain Never: India Ki Takedown Ghadi

segments.line: [COLD OPEN: Reema desk par, haath mein phone] Namaskar, main Reema, aur yeh hai The Late Edit. Pehle facts. Opinions baad mein. Friday ko Indian Youth Congress ke president aur national in-charge ke Instagram accounts restricted the. Workers Meta ke offices pahunche, aur IYC ka daava hai ki 15 minute mein dono accounts wapas. [SFX: microwave ding] Wah. Mere bank ka chargeback 45 din leta hai. Lagta hai main itne saal galat jagah ticket raise kar rahi thi.

[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX — Source: Reuters/CNBC, Hindustan Times, The Hindu] Teen facts. Ek: 20 November ko Youth Congress workers ne Hyderabad, Mumbai aur Gurugram mein Meta offices par protest kiya — IYC president Uday Bhanu Chib aur national in-charge Manish Sharma ke restricted Instagram accounts ko lekar. Hyderabad mein 21 detain, teen ghante baad release. Do: IYC kehti hai accounts restore ho gaye, aur Meta ko 7 din ka ultimatum diya. Meta ne comment nahi kiya; BJP ne vandalism ka aarop lagaya. Teen: Meta ke disclosures — January se June 2026 mein India mein 5.4 million se zyada posts ya accounts restrict. February 2026 mein takedown deadline 36 ghante se 3 ghante hui.

Toh hum yahan pahunche kaise? [PROP: Reema ek bada stopwatch desk par rakhti hai] Yeh hai aaj ka hero. Ise yaad rakhiye.

24 March 2015. Supreme Court, Shreya Singhal case. Court ne IT Act ka Section 66A strike down kiya — woh section jo 'grossly offensive' online messages ko crime banata tha, aur jiske tahat political commentary aur humour tak par cases ho chuke the. Haan, humour par bhi. Is show ka toh pura business model khatre mein tha. Court ne kaha: vague, overbroad, aur free speech par 'chilling effect'. Lekin — aur yeh 'lekin' important hai — Section 69A bach gaya. Yeh sarkar ko content block karne ki power deta hai, safeguards ke saath: committee, sunwai ka mauka, likhit aur reasoned order. Yaani pinjra khula, par chaabi sarkar ke paas rahi.

25 February 2021. IT Rules aaye. Platforms par naye compliance duties, aur unlawful content hatane ke liye 36 ghante ki ghadi. [SFX: stopwatch click] 36 ghante. Note kar lijiye.

30 June 2023. Twitter ne Karnataka High Court mein sarkar ke blocking orders ko challenge kiya. Petition dismiss, upar se 50 lakh rupaye ka exemplary cost. Shikayat bhi aapki, jurmana bhi aapka.

24 September 2025. X phir Karnataka High Court gaya, is baar Home Ministry ke Sahyog portal ke khilaaf, jo October 2024 mein launch hua tha. Indian Express ki RTI ke mutabik, October 2024 se April 2025 ke beech is portal se 130 takedown notices gaye. X ka argument: portal Section 79(3)(b) ke zariye notices bhejta hai aur 69A wale safeguards — committee, sunwai, reasoned order — ko bypass karta hai. Court ne petition dismiss ki, portal ko 'instrument of public good' kaha, aur bola social media ko 'state of anarchic freedom' mein nahi chhoda ja sakta. X ne kaha woh is order ko challenge karega.

Aur February 2026. Deadline 36 ghante se seedha 3 ghante. [SFX: stopwatch click, tez] Teen ghante. Itne mein Bengaluru mein Silk Board cross nahi hota, aur platform ko decide karna hai ki post kanooni hai ya nahi.

[GRAPHIC: timeline — 36 hrs → 3 hrs] Pattern dekhiye. Har kuch saal mein ghadi chhoti hoti gayi. Bas ek timer kabhi start hi nahi hua: user ko yeh batane ka ki uski post kyon gayi.

Ab aaj ki baat. [GRAPHIC: BAR CHART — Meta content restrictions in India: ~70,000 (H2 2025) vs 5.4 million+ (H1 2026). Source: Meta disclosures via Reuters] Reuters ke mutabik, Meta ne 2026 ke pehle chhe mahine mein India mein 5.4 million se zyada posts ya accounts restrict kiye. Pichhle chhe mahine mein lagbhag 70,000 the. Indonesia ke baad duniya mein doosra number. Growth hai, bas galat sector mein.

Official claim? Sarkar kehti hai woh content tabhi hatwati hai jab woh local law tode, ya public safety aur national security ko nuksaan pahunchaye. Meta kehta hai, 'The large majority of these items included instances where we were obligated to proactively restrict content... based on local law requirements.' Sarkar kehti hai law, Meta kehta hai law. Toh sawaal simple hai: kaunsa law, kaunsa order, kis post par? Woh list public nahi hai. IT ministry ne Reuters ko jawab nahi diya.

Kaun affected? IYC ke social media in-charge Manu Jain ne Reuters ko kaha ki journalists aur creators ke hazaaron accounts abhi bhi restricted hain — yeh unka daava hai, verified nahi. Reporters Without Borders kehta hai is saal India mein journalistic content ka removal badha hai.

Aur 15-minute wala twist. Agar restriction legal tha, toh protest ke baad kaise hata? Agar galti thi, toh galti kiski? Dono jawab uncomfortable hain.

Lekin fair rahiye. Reuters ke mutabik IYC ke apne videos mein Hyderabad mein gamle tootte dikhe, Mumbai mein deewaron par spray paint. BJP spokesperson Pradeep Bhandari ne likha, 'This is Congress Model: Vandalise offices of private companies!' Unki politics alag, par yeh point theek hai. Free speech ka case gamle todne se strong nahi hota.

[CUT TO: Siddharth, split screen]

SIDDHARTH: Reema ji, adaab. Seedhi baat. Yeh rules Parliament ke banaye IT Act se aate hain, aur Karnataka High Court ne do baar sarkar ki baat sahi maani. Company videshi ho ya desi, India mein business karegi toh Indian law maanegi. Aur shikayat ho, toh adaalat jaiye — cafeteria nahi.

REEMA: Court ka advice achha hai. Bas X gaya tha, 50 lakh ka bill lekar lauta.

SIDDHARTH: Aur Youth Congress wale gamlon ka bill chhod aaye. Hisaab barabar.

REEMA: Tod-phod ko main defend nahi karti. Par 5.4 million restrictions, bina kisi public list ke? Yeh rule of law kam, rule of 'trust me' zyada lagta hai.

SIDDHARTH: Itna maanta hoon — jiska account jaaye, use wajah toh batayi jaani chahiye.

REEMA: Bas. Wahi. Ek line ka notice. Woh toh teen ghante mein bhi likha ja sakta hai.

Toh aage kya? Teen cheezein badalni chahiye.

Ek: har restriction ke saath user ko notice. Kaunsa law, kaunsi authority, kaunsa order. Supreme Court ne 2015 mein 69A ko isliye bachaya tha kyonki usmein reasoned order aur sunwai ke safeguards the. Woh safeguards file mein dabe nahi, user ko dikhne chahiye.

Do: data. Meta ek total number deta hai. Sarkar bhi publish kare: kitne orders, kis section mein, kitne journalists aur political accounts par. Jab sarkar khud kehti hai ki sirf law todne wala content hatta hai, toh numbers dikhane mein darr kaisa?

Teen: 3 ghante ki deadline ka review. Free speech activists kehte hain itne kam time mein platform theek se review hi nahi kar sakta. Jab penalty ka risk platform par ho aur ghadi chhoti, toh 'pehle delete, baad mein socho' hi rational business hai. Yeh incentives ka problem hai, conspiracy ka nahi.

Aap kya kar sakte hain? Account restrict ho toh screenshot lijiye, platform ki appeal process use kijiye, aur likhit mein wajah maangiye. Aur haan, IYC ne Meta ko 'grow a spine' bola — spine dikhane ka sabse achha tareeka cafeteria nahi, court mein affidavit hai.

Kya dekhna hai? IYC ka 7 din ka ultimatum agle hafte khatam hota hai. Meta jawab deta hai ya chup rehta hai. Aur IT ministry — kya woh batayegi ki in accounts par koi order tha ya nahi? Jab tak yeh jawab nahi aata, sab kuch 'alleged' hai — censorship bhi, aur 'coincidence' bhi.

[PROP: Reema stopwatch uthati hai] Toh recap. 2021 mein takedown ki ghadi: 36 ghante. 2026 mein: 3 ghante. IYC ke mutabik restore hone ki ghadi: 15 minute — par sirf protest ke baad. [SFX: tick tick tick] Aur yeh wali ghadi? Yeh hai explanation ki ghadi. Account kyon gaya, kisne kaha, kis law mein. [CLOSE-UP: stopwatch display 00:00:00] Abhi tak start hi nahi hui. [Reema stopwatch camera ki taraf badhati hai] Meta, sarkar, IYC — jo pehle jawab de, start button yahan hai. Aur jab tak koi nahi dabata, main ise apni desk par rakhungi. [Reema stopwatch ko desk par rakh deti hai, display par 00:00:00 blink karta hai] Kal bhi. Parson bhi.

Aaj kaun jeeta? App mein vote kariye. Good night, aur apni EMI check kar lijiye.

Pehle tathya, phir tark. Samvidhan badalna asaan nahi hona chahiye — isliye Article 368 poore House ka majority aur present-and-voting ka do-tihaai maangta hai. Purkhon ne yeh taala soch-samajh kar lagaya tha. Sarkar ka iraada — mahila aarakshan jaldi laana — nek tha, par sahmati ke bina samvidhan nahi badalta. Ab Jairam ji 1976 mein Indira Gandhi aur 2001 mein Vajpayee ji ke delimitation taalne ki misaal dete hain: 'They were wise and nationalist PMs.' Congress neta Vajpayee ji ki taareef kar rahe hain — delimitation ne chamatkar kar diya. Par sarkar bhi samjhe: chaar chitthiyon ka jawab ek meeting hai.
Reema ji poochhengi, 'deadline kya hai?' Sahi sawaal. 'Viksit Bharat tak freeze' sunne mein achha hai, par calendar mein woh tareekh nahi milti.
Shubh ratri. Aaj kaun jeeta? App mein vote kariye, aur comment mein apna tark bhi likhiye.

scripts.topic: Pokhran Phir Garja: Private Sector Ka Bagheera

segments.line: Pokhran mein phir garaj — is baar kisi sarkari lab se nahi, ek private company se.

[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX] 20 November, Pokhran: Adani Defence ne Bagheera AT1 ke chaar missile fire kiye, din aur raat. Daava: 8 km range, laser guidance, 12 missile per gaadi. Demo: 'No Cost No Commitment'.

Pehle tathya, phir tark. Pokhran ka naam sunte hi hamari peedhi ko 1998 yaad aata hai. [CUT TO: archive footage, Pokhran range] Ab wahan ek Indian private company apna system laayi, 18 mahine mein banakar. Company ke mutabik, laser beam-riding guidance jamming se bachati hai, aur do missile ek hi beam par chalte hain — pehla tank ke protection system ke liye, doosra armour ke liye. Army ab bhi Milan-2T aur Konkurs-M par nirbhar hai. Desh mein bane toh paisa aur hunar dono desh mein rahein. Par daadi kehti thi, 'Haathi ke daant dikhane ke aur, khaane ke aur.' Demo ek baat hai; asli imtihaan Army ke evaluation mein hoga.
Reema ji ko 'No Cost No Commitment' apni gym membership jaisa lagta hai. Farak yeh hai ki Bagheera kam se kam target tak pahuncha.
Shubh ratri. Aaj kaun jeeta? App mein vote kariye, aur doston ko bhi bataiye.

scripts.topic: Chhappar Pehle: Odisha Ka Cyclone Model

segments.line: 24 din mein teesra toofan, aur Odisha phir seedha khada hai. Kaise?

[GRAPHIC: FACT BOX] 20 November: Akvan Gopalpur ke paas coast cross karke depression bana. Odisha ne 4.40 lakh log shift kiye, 423 rescue teams lagayi. Minister: koi badi damage nahi, koi jaan nahi gayi.

Pehle tathya, phir tark. IMD ke DG Mrutyunjay Mohapatra ke mutabik, Akvan kinaare tak pahunchte-pahunchte severe cyclonic storm se cyclonic storm ban gaya, kyonki kinaare ke paas samundar relatively thanda tha. Kudrat ne thodi raahat di; baaki kaam insaan ne kiya — 4.40 lakh log shift, 9,341 shelters, NDRF aur ODRAF zameen par, aur lagbhag 1,450 bachche surakshit janme. Daadi kehti thi, 'Baarish se pehle chhappar theek karo.' Odisha ne kiya. Par imaandari se — Berhampur mein phir paani bhara, jaise pichhle mahine Cyclone Arnab mein hua tha. Shelters world-class, naaliyan ab bhi hamare zamaane wali.
Reema ji poochhengi, 'kisaan ka bill kaun bharega?' Sawaal sahi hai — bas is baar unke chart mein shelters ko bhi jagah mile.
Shubh ratri. Aaj kaun jeeta? App mein vote kariye, aur Odisha ki teams ko salaam.

notes: All four leads checked out; no swaps. META: The protests took place on Friday 20 Nov. HT says the ultimatum was also issued Friday; it was widely reported on 21 Nov. The '15 minutes' restoration is the IYC's own claim (its X post, quoted by The Hindu). Meta declined to comment to Reuters; the IT ministry did not respond. The vandalism is alleged: the BJP's Pradeep Bhandari alleged it, TOI says 'allegedly vandalised', and Reuters describes the IYC's own footage showing plants smashed. Reuters/Independent name Manu Jain as the IYC's social media in-charge (he made the 'thousands of accounts' claim); Manish Sharma is the national in-charge whose account was restricted. They are different people. Previous-period figure: Reuters says about 70,000 in the six months before H1 2026, but one secondary outlet (Internet Freedom Foundation substack) says about 41,000. The chart uses Reuters's ~70,000 with attribution; consider dropping the earlier figure if unsure. Meta's transparency page could not be fetched directly (HTTP 400); its search snippet confirms '5.4 million items in India'. The IT Rules 2021 date (25 Feb 2021) and the original 36-hour takedown window rely on well-established public record plus Legal500's before/after table. The 3-hour rule was notified 10 Feb 2026 and in force 20 Feb (per iPleaders/PolicyCircle); the script just says 'February 2026'. The Sahyog portal launch (Oct 2024, MHA) and X calling it a 'censorship portal' come from the Indian Express explainer. DELIMITATION: no fresh bill has been introduced. Ramesh says nobody knows what a new bill will contain. Vote figures (298/230, House strength 528, 352 needed) are from The Hindu. The Article 368 special-majority explanation is standard constitutional law. The '850 seats' detail (from the linked Delimitation Bill) was left out of the scripts because only Wikipedia and a law blog confirm it. BAGHEERA: all performance claims (8 km, jamming resistance, APS defeat) are the company's own, and the scripts say so. India Today says 'two missiles back-to-back'; Adani's release says four missiles fired in total. 'Pokhran 1998' in Siddharth's short refers to the well-known May 1998 nuclear tests. CYCLONE: evacuation totals differ by time of report. The Statesman (earlier, 20 Nov evening) gives 3.72 lakh; The Hindu and NIE (later) give over 4.40 lakh. We used 4.40 lakh. Babies born: NIE says 1,452, Statesman 1,450, so the scripts say 'around/lagbhag 1,450'. The 12,294/4,470 pregnant-women figures are from The Statesman. The Andhra figures (71,576 farmers, ~₹100 crore sought) relate to the earlier cyclones Arnab and Murasu, not Akvan, and Reema's script frames them that way. A Lord Jagannath quote from the Odisha CM was deliberately not used for comedy, to avoid any religious satire.
